faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services, process, and approach to digital solutions.
faq.stillHaveQuestionsDescription: Can't find the answer you're looking for? We'd be happy to help.

list.question: What services do you offer?
list.answer: We provide comprehensive digital solutions including web development, mobile applications, AI/ML solutions, automation, digital marketing, and DevOps services. Our team specializes in modern technologies and frameworks to deliver scalable, efficient solutions.

list.question: How long does a typical project take?
list.answer: Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. A simple website typically takes 2-4 weeks, while complex web applications or mobile apps can take 8-16 weeks. We provide detailed timelines during our initial consultation and keep you updated throughout the development process.

list.question: What is your development process?
list.answer: We follow an agile development methodology with regular sprints and client feedback cycles. Our process includes discovery, planning, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. We maintain transparent communication throughout each phase.

list.question: Do you provide ongoing support and maintenance?
list.answer: Yes, we offer comprehensive support and maintenance packages. This includes regular updates, security patches, performance monitoring, bug fixes, and feature enhancements. We also provide 24/7 technical support for critical issues.

list.question: Can you work with existing systems?
list.answer: Absolutely. We have extensive experience integrating with existing systems, databases, and third-party services. We can modernize legacy systems, create APIs for integration, and ensure seamless data migration when needed.

list.question: What technologies do you specialize in?
list.answer: Our expertise includes React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, React Native, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and various AI/ML frameworks. We stay current with emerging technologies and select the best tools for each project.

list.question: How do you ensure project quality?
list.answer: We implement rigorous quality assurance processes including code reviews, automated testing, performance optimization, security audits, and user acceptance testing. All deliverables undergo thorough testing before deployment.

list.question: What are your pricing models?
list.answer: We offer flexible pricing models including fixed-price projects, hourly rates, and retainer agreements. Pricing depends on project scope, complexity, and timeline. We provide detailed quotes after understanding your specific requirements.

items.question: Should I choose REST or GraphQL for my API?
items.answer: It depends on your use case. REST is ideal for simple, resource-based operations and has broad tooling support. GraphQL excels when clients need flexible data fetching or when you have multiple client types with different data needs. We'll help you choose the best approach.

items.question: How do you ensure API security?
items.answer: We implement multiple security layers including OAuth 2.0/JWT authentication, HTTPS encryption, input validation, rate limiting, IP whitelisting, and SQL injection prevention. We also conduct security audits before deployment.

items.question: Can you integrate with our existing systems?
items.answer: Absolutely. We specialize in API integration with legacy systems, third-party services, payment gateways, CRMs, ERPs, and any system with an available API or database access. We can also create middleware layers for incompatible systems.

items.question: What documentation do you provide?
items.answer: We create comprehensive API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI specification, including interactive testing interfaces, code examples in multiple languages, authentication guides, and error code references.

items.question: How do you handle API versioning?
items.answer: We implement semantic versioning with URL path versioning (v1, v2) or header-based versioning. We maintain backward compatibility and provide migration guides when breaking changes are necessary.

items.question: What about API monitoring and analytics?
items.answer: We set up comprehensive monitoring including response time tracking, error rate monitoring, usage analytics, and alerting. You'll have dashboards showing API health, popular endpoints, and performance metrics.
